settlement-survey-methods.alt: Three panels drawn from above. Metes and bounds: odd-shaped fields whose edges follow a winding stream, a tree and a rock. Township and range: a grid of equal squares with straight roads at right angles. Long lot: narrow strips of land side by side, each running back from a river, with a farmhouse at the river end of each strip.

settlement-survey-methods-numbered.alt: Three numbered panels drawn from above. Panel 1: odd-shaped fields whose edges follow a winding stream, a tree and a rock. Panel 2: a grid of equal squares with straight roads at right angles and a few farmhouses. Panel 3: narrow strips of land side by side, each running back from a river, with a house at the river end of each strip.

settlement-survey-patterns.alt: Three panels drawn from above. Clustered: about a dozen houses packed together in one village, with fields all around it. Dispersed: a grid of farm fields with one farmhouse standing alone on each field. Linear: houses lined up along both sides of one winding road, with fields behind them.
